newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai oil depot blast kills 11, injures at least 17. [CORRECTED 13:16 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Thai oil depot blast kills 11, injures at least 17. [CORRECTED 13:16 GMT]

text.p: At least 11 people, including one woman, were killed and 17 injured on Thursday when a bunker oil depot caught fire and exploded in Thailand's eastern Rayong province, police and hospital staff said. (Corrects to show no children were killed).
Nurses quoted police and injured workers as saying that about another dozen people may still be trapped and presumed dead in the blaze which lasted more than five hours after the initial explosion.
Police said they were investigating the blast at the depot, which stored most of its oil in underground tanks.
They said the injured included women and children.
Police estimated that the depot, owned by Rungmeesap Petroleum Ltd Partnership, stored about three million litres of oil at the time of the blast.
